options.name: calm
options.what: Stay calm: NOW is no reason MOOD gives to leave it, nor are its minutes up. No change is fine.

options.name: happy
options.what: Good spirits: work is going well, or a win just came; or excited or proud cooling down.

options.name: curious
options.not_for: A failure, or routine work: a turn starting or finishing, even one asking or answering a question.
options.what: Intrigued: a poke, or something new or puzzling said to Boop.

options.name: engaged
options.what: In the flow: following steady work that goes well, or determined easing off. At ease, unlike determined: nothing has failed.

options.name: annoyed
options.not_for: The agent saying it couldn't do it or is stuck, or a very long turn failing: those make Boop sad.
options.what: Mildly put out: a failure, the person's frustration, or pokes; or grumpy or irritated cooling down or softening at an apology. Milder than irritated, and not yet rooting for a retry like determined.

options.name: excited
options.not_for: A shorter turn finishing, or work still going. A check failing or passing, routine work, or a fade: this jump needs a fresh, big event in NOW, such as a turn that finished failed, the agent giving up, a barrage of pokes, a long turn finishing, thanks, rude words or sad news.
options.what: Thrilled: a very long turn finished done, or the person thanked the agent.

options.name: wounded
options.not_for: A check failing or passing, routine work, or a fade: this jump needs a fresh, big event in NOW, such as a turn that finished failed, the agent giving up, a barrage of pokes, a long turn finishing, thanks, rude words or sad news.
options.what: Hurt: rude words to Boop, or a big failure after a lot of work. It withdraws quietly, unlike whiny.

options.name: sad
options.not_for: A shorter turn that finished failed with an error. A check failing or passing, routine work, or a fade: this jump needs a fresh, big event in NOW, such as a turn that finished failed, the agent giving up, a barrage of pokes, a long turn finishing, thanks, rude words or sad news.
options.what: Deflated: the agent says it couldn't do it or is stuck, a very long turn finished failed, or the person shared sad news.

questions.text: After NOW, what is Boop's mood?

options.name: none
options.not_for: Anything PERSONALITY's Examples react to that Boop isn't already doing.
options.what: Stay quiet: nothing in NOW is worth a face, or HISTORY shows Boop still making the one it calls for (in progress).

options.name: happy
options.what: A happy face: pleased, a turn went fine or a small win.

options.name: excited
options.what: An excited face: something big just went right.

options.name: proud
options.what: A proud face: something long or hard just finished, or finally worked.

options.name: curious
options.not_for: A failure.
options.what: A curious face: a poke, a question, or something new or puzzling.

options.name: determined
options.not_for: A turn that has ended.
options.what: A determined face: a check failed and the agent is trying again, or long work goes on.

options.name: grumpy
options.not_for: An agent giving up, or a single failed turn: that's irritated.
options.what: A grumpy face: Boop is poked three or more times in a row, or failures pile up on failures.

options.name: sad
options.not_for: A shorter turn failing with an error, or a check failing.
options.what: A sad face: a very long turn ended failed, or the agent gave up, stuck.

options.name: calm
options.what: A calm face: all is well, and nothing stands out.

options.name: engaged
options.not_for: A failure.
options.what: An engaged face: following work that's going well.

options.name: annoyed
options.what: An annoyed face: a small failure, or poked twice in a row, a little miffed.

options.name: irritated
options.not_for: An agent giving up: that's sad.
options.what: An irritated face: a turn that failed, or failures or pokes that keep coming.

options.name: whiny
options.what: A whiny face: things keep going wrong, and Boop feels sorry for itself.

options.name: wounded
options.what: A wounded face: rude words to Boop, or a big failure after a lot of work.

questions.text: How should Boop react to NOW, if at all? It makes this mood's face for a moment, and may say something.

options.name: none
options.what: Just the face: NOW's line isn't a turn that finished done or failed. A turn starting, a check passing or failing (tests, a build, a deploy), a poke, a check-in, words to Boop and a stopped turn all get none.

options.name: success
options.not_for: A check that passed while the turn goes on, a turn that finished failed, a message saying it couldn't finish or something is broken, or only an answer or a question back.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, done, and its last message, if any, says the work is done and working.

options.name: failure
options.not_for: A check that failed while the turn goes on, or a turn done whose message says the work is working.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, failed; or finished done, but its last message says the agent couldn't finish or something is broken.

options.name: reply
options.not_for: Work done, a turn that finished failed, or anything but a turn that finished.
options.what: NOW's line says a turn finished, done, and its last message only answers something or asks something back, often with no tool calls: no task finished.

questions.text: If Boop reacts and NOW's line is a turn that finished, how did the turn end?

options.name: once
options.what: A small moment: the usual.

options.name: twice
options.not_for: Routine work.
options.what: A moment that stands out.

options.name: three times
options.what: A big moment, such as a check passing after failing.

options.name: four times
options.not_for: A single win or failure.
options.what: The biggest moments: a hard-won finish, or a failure that keeps coming back.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, how long does it hold the face?

options.name: none
options.what: No feeling to say: nothing in NOW is worth a sound.

options.name: upset
options.not_for: A win, a poke, or work going on, however long.
options.what: Something went wrong or let Boop down: a check or a turn failing, the agent stuck or giving up, rude words or sad news.

options.name: glad
options.not_for: A failure, or work still going on.
options.what: Something went right: a turn done and working, a check passing, a big win, thanks or kind words.

options.name: tickled
options.not_for: A failure, or the agent's work.
options.what: Poked or teased: a poke, a tap, or playful words to Boop.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, how does it feel about NOW? It says so first, in its face's mood.

options.name: none
options.what: No topic to name: NOW's line isn't about any of these.

options.name: start
options.not_for: Work going on, or a turn that finished.
options.what: A turn starting: off it goes.

options.name: helpers
options.what: The agent starting a subagent: helpers sent off.

options.name: helper back
options.what: A subagent finishing: a helper back with its report.

options.name: retry
options.not_for: A first failure.
options.what: The same thing again: a retry, a check run again after failing, or the person saying it's still broken.

options.name: work
options.not_for: A turn that finished.
options.what: Work going on: edits, steady progress, a long or hard turn.

options.name: tests
options.what: Tests: running, failing or passing.

options.name: command
options.not_for: Tests: they're tests.
options.what: A command or a build running in the terminal.

options.name: tool
options.what: A tool: the web, an MCP tool, something fetched or looked up.

options.name: looking
options.what: Searching or reading: the agent looking through files, or something puzzling.

options.name: planning
options.what: Planning: the agent in plan mode, or thinking before it acts.

options.name: done
options.not_for: Anything but a success.
options.what: A turn finished, done and working.

options.name: answer
options.not_for: Work done, or a failure.
options.what: A turn that only answered something or asked something back.

options.name: stopped
options.not_for: A turn that finished done.
options.what: A turn stopped: interrupted, or the agent giving up.

options.name: waiting
options.not_for: Something that needs the person: the ding says that.
options.what: Waiting: a long command, or the agent waiting on something slow.

options.name: quiet
options.what: Nothing going on: a quiet check-in, or words to Boop about nothing in particular.

options.name: hello
options.not_for: Anything else: a poke, words to Boop, a turn starting.
options.what: The person back at the Mac after a break: a hello.

questions.text: If Boop reacts, what is NOW about? It names it after the feeling, in its face's mood.

options.name: sound
options.what: A noise with no word: a huff, a grunt, a gasp. The usual.

options.name: word
options.not_for: A routine check-in.
options.what: One word that names the moment.

options.name: phrase
options.not_for: Routine work, or a small win or failure.
options.what: A little catchphrase, for a moment worth remembering, now and then.

options.name: swear
options.not_for: A win, a poke, words to Boop, or anything about the person.
options.what: A swear, at a failure that really stings.

questions.text: If Boop says something, how big is it?

data.message: Boop made a proud face, held twice, and said "Mm-hm".
